name: passive_mae_opening_excursion_reversal
economic_rationale: Intraday price structurally travels significantly further against initial opening range direction (MAE) than with it (MFE) due to market maker inventory replenishment. Passive limit liquidity placed at the ex-ante adverse excursion boundary captures this inventory rebalance flow at favorable prices without paying aggressive taker friction.

mae_mfe_definition.long_breakout_mae: max(0, Close_07:30 - min(Bid_t)) for t in 07:31..15:00
mae_mfe_definition.long_breakout_mfe: max(0, max(Ask_t) - Close_07:30) for t in 07:31..15:00
mae_mfe_definition.short_breakout_mae: max(0, max(Ask_t) - Close_07:30) for t in 07:31..15:00
mae_mfe_definition.short_breakout_mfe: max(0, Close_07:30 - min(Bid_t)) for t in 07:31..15:00

quantitative_boundary_formula.direction_rule: Initial break direction determined by sign of (Close_07:30 - Open_07:00)

execution_rules.unfilled_handling: CANCEL_AT_15:00 (zero realized PnL, track opportunity cost separately)
execution_rules.position_exit: MARKET_CLOSE_AT_15:00_UTC (Bid_15:00 for Longs, Ask_15:00 for Shorts)

random_boundary_control.method: Uniform random boundary in [0.5 * OR, 1.5 * OR]

Q1_descriptive_asymmetry_replicates.metric: MAE > MFE paired Wilcoxon signed-rank p-value

Q2a_information_integrity.requirement: Zero data after 07:30:00 UTC used in limit calculation (enforced by audit test)

Q2b_economic_predictability.decision_rule: Delta Expectancy = (Expectancy_Fixed - Expectancy_Random_Mean) > 0 with paired p < 0.05, and Fixed Expectancy > 90th percentile of N=500 Monte Carlo distribution

Q3_passive_fill_accessibility_and_advers.adverse_runaway_limit_pct: Post-fill MAE > 2.0 * OR in < 25% of filled trades

Q4_net_expectancy_and_cost_survivability.metric: Net expectancy per filled trade after IBKR per-order min fee ($4.00 round-trip min) and quote spreads
